# Vicoco Squoosh Batch Image Compressor

> A free batch image compressor powered by Squoosh codecs and processed locally in the browser.

## Main resource

- [Squoosh Batch Image Compressor](https://vicoco.uk/squoosh-batch-image-compressor/): Compress, resize, and convert multiple JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and SVG images.

## Workflow

- Add multiple images, a folder, dropped files, or a pasted image.
- Compare image quality and file size in the Vicoco editor.
- Apply format, quality, and resize settings to the complete queue.
- Export processed images together as a ZIP.

## Privacy

- Image processing runs locally in the browser.
- Source images are not uploaded to a processing server.

## Related resource

- [Free Image Compressor](https://vicoco.uk/): Compress individual images online for free.
